votes.section: APPROVAL OF NON-COMMERCIAL HANGAR PAD LICENSING POLICY
votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Kemp to approve the Non-Commercial Hangar Pad Licensing Policy with the following conditions/edits: Section 3.6.1 change from a 2-year period to a 3-year period; Section 3.6.2 based aircraft that are stored in a hangar having to fly at least – they must be stored in a hangar at least 14 days out of any 12-month period; and changing exceeding a 6-month period without flying to a 12-month period.
